summary.name: Trello
summary.one_liner: Trello is a collaboration tool that organizes projects and to-dos into Kanban-style boards, with Inbox and Planner views.
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Trello as a tool for staying organized with three parts: Inbox, Boards, and Planner. It says every to-do, idea, or responsibility can be captured and placed in one of these. It mentions easy integrations, automation, and mirroring of to-dos across multiple locations. It also says Inbox, Boards, and Planner can be used from anywhere, including on mobile. Email and messaging app features are referenced by headings, but no details are given.
notable: Inbox, Boards, and Planner views for organizing work
Integrations, automation, and mirroring of to-dos across locations
Listed in awesome-mac as freeware with a Mac App Store link
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Page is mostly marketing; specific feature details are limited
The 75% value claim is a vendor statistic and is not independently verified
